verdicts.note: Passage shows a meaningful, football-plausible drop and is marked as passing rules.
Alternative carry reduces chance notably and is marked as passing rules.
Marked as not passing rules in the input.

claim: Theo Varga’s pass to Felix Ondo created an 11.0% chance to score; had Varga shot himself the chance would have been 2.7% (−8.3 points), and had he carried the ball the chance would have been 7.4% (−3.6 points).
